description.narrative: The TMEA SCT project is designed to contribute to the Single Customs Territory at two different levels. Firstly, to support the EAC Secretariat at the regional level by supporting the formation of the High-Level Task Force (HLTF) to develop the framework for the operationalization of the Single Customs Territory; and secondly, initiate programs that would enhance the implementation of the SCT. Specific key areas of support include but not limited to the SCT Centralized Platform/System to support data exchange under Single Customs Territory, EAC Customs Bond, development and update of SCT implementation instruments as well as the Northern/Central Corridors ECTS interface.
